operations_protocol._description: Gawande-style meta-checklist for the whole repo. One row per transition point where complexity creates failure modes; each row points at the canonical document holding the actual checklist. Apply at every operational moment — new analysis, push, cowork session start/end, AI cold-start, push failure, corpus drift, doc update, reviewer audit.

cnq_engine._description: Production CNQ engine shipped in push #26. Compiled sibling to cnt.py. Reads CNT JSON or runs CNT via portable adapter; computes the quaternion-native view via Helmert + sandwich-product reconstruction; emits hash-chained CNQ JSON with parent_cnt_content_sha256 + cnq_content_sha256.
cnq_engine.dependencies: Python 3.9+, numpy. No other runtime deps.
cnq_engine.portability: No hardcoded paths. Auto-detects repo root via .git / HCI-CNQ / HCI-CNT / ai-refresh markers. --repo-root and --cnt-engine overrides supported.
cnq_engine.determinism: Canonical JSON serialization (sorted keys, no whitespace, ASCII-safe, clock fields stripped). Two runs on same CNT JSON produce identical cnq_content_sha256.

Project shifted from 1st-order linear into multi-carrier, multi-dimensional, then quaternion algebra and proposed tensor-order ladder in weeks; vocabulary did not keep pace until ChatGPT round-2 audit + Peter's terminology directive prompted unification.

key_corrections.tensor_order_vs_rank: Use 'order' for index count; reserve 'rank' for matrix rank or tensor-decomposition rank.
key_corrections.kappa_tensor_vs_sj_vector: kappa^HS_ij is the order-2 Aitchison pullback metric; s_j = 1/x_j is the order-1 carrier sensitivity vector. Distinct objects.
key_corrections.twin_quaternion_factoring: INV-029's SU(2) x SU(2) factoring is formally 'twin-quaternion factoring', not 'bi-quaternion' (H tensor C). Legacy filename and dimension-policy label retained for repo-history continuity.

notation_terminology.citation_policy: Every doc using a defined term should cite NOTATION_AND_TERMINOLOGY.md. New terms enter via Investigation Catalog + entry in this canonical doc.
